agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/grouping.py: group_period()'s post callback had its ternary branches inverted, causing tokens that should extend a dotted Identifier (e.g. wildcards after '.', quoted names, function calls) to be excluded instead of included. This broke Identifier/IdentifierList grouping broadly, cascading into failures in reindent formatting, wildcard detection, and JSON-ops-related grouping. Swapped the branches back to `(pidx, nidx) if valid_next else (pidx, tidx)`. Verified the originally reported case (`select a.*,b from a, b` reindented) and several related cases (multiple wildcards, array indexing, JSON arrow operators) now produce correct output with no regressions observed.
